messages:
alex: heads-up — we started seeing GPU pod scheduling failures in prod ~10m ago. kubelet logs show KMS decrypt errors and API server token validation failures.

alex: log snippet: 
```
E0320 14:07:12.345678 1 controller.go:123] pod create failed: Decrypt failed: rpc error: code=5 desc=kms: key version not found (key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/sa-keys/cryptoKeys/privsep-signer, version: 2)
Status: Unauthorized
```

sara: :eyes: did rotation run overnight? I remember a rotation job targeting privsep-signer at 02:00 UTC.

kms-rotation-bot: Automated rotation complete: privsep-signer v2 created by rotation-job-2026-03-20T02:00Z. AuditID: rot-9f4a.

matt: mm — looks like new key version exists but IAM/grants for decrypt may not have been updated for the proxy SA. If the signer cannot decrypt old envelopes the agent tokens become invalid.

jess: we need to be careful. quick fix options: 1) re-add decrypt permission for sa-privsep-proxy to the new key version, or 2) temporarily allow gpu-scheduler to impersonate sufficiently-scoped SAs so it can continue scheduling while we fix KMS policy. prefer 1 but do it via least-privileged change.

alex: I can push a scoped IAM binding for the new key version that grants kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt to the service account used by the privsep proxy. quick command: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding privsep-signer \
  --location global --keyring sa-keys \
  --member serviceAccount:sa-privsep-proxy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Do we want to do that now?

sara: +1 to that, but ensure it's limited to the specific key version if possible. Also add an audit entry so we can revert if anything weird.

matt: if we patch IAM, let's also add a short-lived feature flag in the scheduler to fall back to rewrapped tokens (we have code for that). That reduces blast radius.

jess: don't add broad impersonation bindings. If we must, limit to namespace and single verb: "impersonate" of specific SAs. Example RBAC snippet: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: gpu-workloads
  name: gpu-scheduler-impersonate-limited
rules:
- apiGroups: ["" ]
  resources: ["serviceaccounts"]
  verbs: ["impersonate"]
```
Then RoleBinding to the scheduler SA. But again, consensus is to fix KMS binding.

alex: rolling the gcloud binding now to add decrypt role to privsep-signer v2 for sa-privsep-proxy. will also annotate the change in the key's metadata with ticket #SEC-1423.

deploy-bot: canary: rewrapped tokens pushed to staging by deploy-bot at 14:24 UTC.

oncall: monitoring prod scheduler — queue backlog peaked but dropping after partial fix.

matt: good. jess — for the longer term we should update the rotation runbook to include: 
- verify IAM bindings for all consuming SAs
- run a decrypt smoke test using each consumer
- push a canary to staging before global rotation
- auto-emit an alert if any decrypt RPC returns NOT_FOUND for new version

jess: agree. also add an audit query snippet we can use post-rotation: 
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND severity=ERROR" --limit=50
```
and filter on principalEmail to find failing SA.

sara: putting together a follow-up PR to rotation-job to include the smoke test and logging. I'll also add a checklist item to the runbook to open an incident if decrypt errors > 5 in 5m.

alex: prod is stable for now after IAM change and rewrapping. will revoke the temporary binding once rotation job includes the smoke test and we've re-run it.

security: please create a short postmortem-style note with timeline + root cause and attach the runbook PR. we need to track this for compliance audits.

alex: creating ticket SEC-1423 with timeline and actions. owner: alex. follow-ups: sara to update rotation job, jess to add audit queries to playbook, matt to add scheduler fallback feature flag, oncall to monitor for 24h.

oncall: acked. will watch alerts and escalate if anything reappears. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone. closing thread when runbook PR merged and IAM binding revoked.
